summary: Symbolic regression (polynomial/linear search) on monthly global mean albedo (301 months): linear 6-predictor model achieves R²=0.882, polynomial degree-2 achieves R²=0.940. The global mean albedo has very low variability (mean=0.2981, std=0.0091 — only 3% relative variation). CLOUD AREA ALONE explains R²=0.468 (dominant single predictor). The SW_clr/solar ratio (H002-style physics ratio) only achieves R²=0.200. INTERPRETATION: Global mean albedo IS highly predictable from a small set of variables (supports H002's premise that system is constrained), but the dominant predictor is a VARIABLE feature (clouds) rather than invariant physical constants. The extremely low global mean variability (~0.009 std) is itself supportive of H002 — something strongly constrains the mean near ~29.8%. The polynomial achieving R²=0.94 with 21 terms suggests the constraint is not fully captured by simple physics ratios.
